description: This seminar integrates the liberal arts with the experience of healthcare work and the search for
vocation or career. Course content will include both an off-campus internship and on-campus
class sessions that connect academic theories/analyses of work with their particular internship
experience. Students will also consider and articulate the value of the liberal arts for their
pursuit of a creative, productive, and satisfying professional life in the healthcare world.
Offered during January Term. Prerequisite: Junior or senior standing.
